def semver_sort(versions):
    def parse_version(v):
        # Split on '+' to separate build metadata (which we ignore)
        v_without_build = v.split('+')[0]
        
        # Split on '-' to separate pre-release
        if '-' in v_without_build:
            base, prerelease = v_without_build.split('-', 1)
        else:
            base = v_without_build
            prerelease = None
        
        # Parse MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH
        parts = base.split('.')
        major = int(parts[0])
        minor = int(parts[1]) if len(parts) > 1 else 0
        patch = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0
        
        # Parse pre-release identifiers
        prerelease_identifiers = []
        if prerelease:
            prerelease_identifiers = prerelease.split('.')
            # Convert to comparable format: (is_digit, value)
            # where is_digit=False sorts after is_digit=True (so we negate)
            prerelease_identifiers = [
                (False, identifier) if not identifier.isdigit() else (True, int(identifier))
                for identifier in prerelease_identifiers
            ]
        
        # For sorting:
        # - Version without pre-release sorts after same version with pre-release
        # - So we use (has_prerelease, prerelease_identifiers) where has_prerelease=True means no prerelease
        has_prerelease = prerelease is None
        
        return (major, minor, patch, has_prerelease, prerelease_identifiers)
    
    # Create list of (sort_key, index, version) tuples
    indexed_versions = [
        (parse_version(v), i, v)
        for i, v in enumerate(versions)
    ]
    
    # Sort by the parsed key, then by original index (for stable sort)
    indexed_versions.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    
    # Extract and return the sorted versions
    return [v for _, _, v in indexed_versions]
